Tenancy._comment: The X-Tenant-Id shim is opt-in outside Development (Inv-13). The integration suite drives the API through that header, so the Test host asks for it explicitly rather than the production default being loosened to keep tests green.

Authorization._comment: X-Actor-Role is asserted, not proven, so an asserted role authorizes a mutation only where asserted identity is already the posture — Development and this test host (Inv-11). Opted into explicitly here for the same reason as the tenant shim above: the suite drives the console's reschedule through those headers, and the production default stays fail-closed. See MutationAuthorizationTests for the gate-off case.

Secrets._comment: TEST-ONLY AES key for the encrypted object store (base64, 32 bytes). Never a real secret.

TenantContextSigningKeys._comment: TEST-ONLY spec-15 JWS signing keys (base64 HMAC secrets). Never real secrets.
